title.en: The poet, the speaker and the situation

hook.en: Can two people live in the same house for years and still not know each other? Elizabeth Jennings gives voice to a father who feels exactly that about his grown-up son.

objectives.en: Introduce Elizabeth Jennings and her style
Identify the speaker and the person he speaks about
State the central problem of the poem

narration.en: Can two people live in the same house for years and still not know each other? Elizabeth Jennings gives voice to a father who feels exactly that about his grown-up son.

body.en: Elizabeth Jennings (1926–2001) was an English poet known for clear, simple language and deeply personal, reflective lyrics. Her poems often explore love, loneliness, faith and family relationships. "Father to Son" is a short lyric in four regular stanzas.

narration.en: Elizabeth Jennings (1926–2001) was an English poet known for clear, simple language and deeply personal, reflective lyrics. Her poems often explore love, loneliness, faith and family relationships. "Father to Son" is a short lyric in four regular stanzas.
Let us place the father at the centre and draw what surrounds him in the poem.

say.en: At the centre is the father, who speaks the whole poem in the first person.
His son is grown up and feels distant, though they live together.
They have shared one house for years, yet remain strangers.
The father tries to rebuild the bond from memories of the son as a small child.
His deepest wish is to forgive and to be close again.

body.en: The speaker is a father who admits, with pain, that he does not understand his son even though they have shared one home for years. The son is now grown up and has his own interests, and the father feels shut out. The whole poem is the father's honest inner reflection.

points.en: Problem: lack of understanding and communication

problem.en: What is the central problem in "Father to Son"?

steps.en: Identify the people: a father and his grown-up son.
Identify the problem: they live together but do not understand each other.
Add the feeling: the father is sad and wants to rebuild the relationship.

answer.en: The central problem is a lack of understanding between a father and his grown-up son. Though they have lived together for years, they behave like strangers, and the father sadly longs to rebuild their relationship.
